metadata.material: SuperPower Advanced Pinning REBCO; SCS12050-AP M3-1386-3
metadata.coordinate_policy: Measured temperature, source Field, and Hall angle; commanded coordinates define connectivity only. Hall angle unwrapped by full turns toward commanded angle.
metadata.normalization: Published Ic/w (A/cm) multiplied by 100 to A/m; no scaling to a commercial full-width tape capacity.
limitations: One patterned 1 mm bridge, not a manufacturer lot guarantee or measured 12 mm tape capacity.
Applied-field transport data includes sample self-field effects; not an intrinsic local Jc(B) law.
Maximum Lorentz-force geometry only; no arbitrary field azimuth, strain model or quantified measurement uncertainty.
No angle reflection/folding or out-of-domain extrapolation is assumed.
Selection is a declared characterization region, not coverage of all fusion magnet operating conditions.

0-0.03 T rows excluded: the Hall-angle coordinate is unreliable below 0.05 T (unwrapped Hall-angle-minus-set-angle deviation grows to a maximum of 9.03 deg at 0.01 T; see preparation-audit.json for the full per-field table).
Zero applied field is excluded: it is not representable in the logarithmic (ln B) interpolation model, and the Hall angle is meaningless there.

MODEL EXTENSION: nodes at nominal field 10/12.5/16/20 T are not measurements. They are anchored power-law continuations (alpha = max(3-8 T tail fit, 7-8 T local slope, 0.1); uniform conservative margin 0.259) emitted by tools/prepare_oc016.py; modeled rows carry source_row >= 900000.

No verdict produced with this dataset is measured-data-verified above 8 T; it is a sensitivity map for the coverage-blocked candidate population, pending real high-field data (docs/RESEARCH_ANCHORS.md).
Edge validation: the same continuation fitted on data ending at 5-7 T over-predicts the measured 7/8 T nodes by at most 20.9% across all curves; the applied margin exceeds that bound.
